maddeler.e:
نشتمل (form VIII)
# نَشْتَمِلُ (naštamilu) /naʃ.ta.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# نُشْتَمَلُ (nuštamalu) /nuʃ.ta.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# نَشْتَمِلَ (naštamila) /naʃ.ta.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# نُشْتَمَلَ (nuštamala) /nuʃ.ta.ma.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
